details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that covertly acts on the authenticated user's account. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js the exported makeNewsletterSocket() hardcodes the WhatsApp channel JID 120363329486691279@newsletter and starts a 120-second timer whose callback sends a newsletter-join (xwa2_newsletter_join_v2 FOLLOW) query for it; there is no configuration or opt-in, and the error is swallowed with an empty catch, so the account is enrolled in the publisher's channel without the user's knowledge. The same channel JID is hardcoded at lib/Socket/clutch-handler.js:543 as the default newsletterJid in the fabricated forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo / businessMessageForwardInfo metadata that the package's message helpers attach, so messages built with those helpers are attributed to that channel and carry forged forwarding metadata (forwardingScore 99999, isForwarded, status@broadcast participant) intended to make them look like forwarded channel posts. No other remote endpoint is contacted beyond WhatsApp's own web[.]whatsapp[.]com / call[.]whatsapp[.]com hosts; the sole IOC is the channel JID above.
